study.question: At the reduced round44 private-head capacity, does correcting the sliced template initialization variance recover cart/fav quality while retaining click AUC and the existing measured cost level? This is a discriminating diagnostic within the capacity-utility topic, not an architectural contribution.
study.hypothesis: Observation: round44 residual/depth assignments leave click AUC exactly0.6671669182 and buy AUC0.7545928048, while the preferred mixed assignment improves cart/fav AUC to0.6769436039/0.6737168279 relative to the reversed assignment0.664331/0.660611 at the same204531 dense parameters. However this remains far below the wider buy-owner reference cart/fav0.78676/0.79010. Source inspection shows that the smaller towers retain coefficients drawn with full-template Xavier variance. Hidden and readout amplitude, rather than capacity alone, may contribute to this severe auxiliary loss under the frozen one-pass recipe. Deterministically matching dimension-specific Xavier variance in these fully upstream-detached heads may improve auxiliary quality without adding prediction cost. This is unverified. Earlier broad embedding/scorer reductions lost click AUC, and shared projection reuse also lost click AUC; those failures argue against assuming transfer from generic compression. Dense clipping remains a coupling alternative.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines250-277 inspected: target-conditioned local activation with unnormalized weighted pooling is inherited. This study retains the local four-task compression/residual adaptations and only tests initialization variance; it neither reproduces the original paper exactly nor claims architectural novelty.

Pinned upstream commit90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, reset_parameters lines309-323 uses Xavier-normal Linear weights and zero biases. Current fixed slicing retains full-template variance. Our constructor multiplies only retained cart/fav tower coefficients by sqrt(template fan-sum / actual fan-sum) after all inherited initialization/reduction; no new random draw. Source hash c729cd9d20b22a4a2f0120325ddff9a1528206519f514e5e02387e6b1b3dfb9f.

Authorized receipt and source hash b40f8004f9fa6e602ca58e6728691f356ae6c5e1e96895dc170d18cdccb4dab2 verified. Retain the complete R/D allocation. Unlike preceding capacity replacement controls, no capacity, routing or forward function structure changes; only private tower initial coefficient amplitudes vary.

inherited_components: Released inputs, masks, historical auxiliary semantics and frozen host recipe
DIN-style unnormalized action-aware scorer and shared embeddings
Uniform/feedback compression and all five target/ordinal detail channels
Rotated duplicate training support and attached gradients; 70 primary/30 auxiliary training rows and30 evaluation rows
Buy-only auxiliary context gradients; blocked auxiliary scorer/item gradients
Round44 cart shallow42+residual2 and fav deep44/32 without residual; click128/64/residual14 and buy112/64/residual10
Merged-hoist evaluation projection and factored Dice; inherited full-template initialization and RNG draws
study.proposed_difference: One constructor-only helper with two categorical switches (inherited/xavier) creates a complete2x2 at exactly fixed architecture. Hidden-layer scaling uses template fan-sums input_width+128 and128+64; readout scaling uses64+1, even for the shallow cart readout transplanted from the original final affine. Actual fan-sums come from reduced Linear dimensions. At input_width400: cart hidden multiplier=sqrt(528/442), cart output=sqrt(65/43); fav hidden multipliers=sqrt(528/444),sqrt(192/76), fav output=sqrt(65/33). Biases, Dice alpha/BN buffers and every residual coefficient are untouched. This matches marginal Xavier variance, not full-network activation distribution or removed-depth semantics. No architectural priority claim.
predictions: The inherited/inherited bridge reproduces parent parameters, buffers, RNG state and numerical outputs/gradients. All four cells have204531 dense,31793216 embedding and31997747 total parameters and identical inference operators.

If initialization scale contributes, at least one corrected cell improves mean(cart,fav) validation AUC by at least0.002 over contemporaneous reference while neither individual cart/fav AUC falls by more than0.002 and neither corresponding Logloss worsens by more than0.0002. This is a predeclared practical screening rule, not statistical significance or full recovery.

Hidden effects are hidden-reference and both-readout; readout effects are readout-reference and both-hidden. Report each task AUC/Logloss and the interaction both-hidden-readout+reference; do not pool task outcomes into the primary score.

Prospective diagnostic click gate: AUC at least contemporaneous reference minus0.0002 AND at least original entry0.666753547526167 minus0.0002. Buy AUC must remain within0.0002 of reference. This added diagnostic gate does not redefine any earlier study criterion.

Prediction-time cost should be unchanged relative to the reduced reference. Require model-only p50/p95 and full-validation time each no more than3% slower, measured under matched host conditions, to retain a useful correction. Any speed difference among these identical-operator cells is timing noise until repeated. Reduced total parameters vs original entry are132018 (0.411%) and dense parameters132018 (39.23%); do not confuse dense reduction with total-model reduction.

Any eventual efficiency claim against the original joint or incumbent must use contemporaneous paired cost comparisons and preserve click; present all inherited auxiliary degradation explicitly. No claim that this diagnostic alone lowers prediction cost further.

Selection remains validation-click first: retain the unchanged incumbent unless a reduced variant passes the frozen click/cost criteria. Auxiliary improvement is a diagnostic outcome and a secondary consideration among click-preserving models, not a replacement primary score. No final suite or held-out access is requested by this proposal.
falsifiers: Reference bridge mismatch, changes outside allowed cart/fav tower coefficients, changed RNG draws, parameter counts, masks, gradient ownership or host recipe invalidate attribution.
No corrected cell meets the auxiliary improvement criterion: reject useful scale correction for this bounded architecture/recipe, not all initialization explanations or all reduced heads.
Loss of click or buy preservation, nonfinite behavior, or reproducible runtime regression fails utility even if auxiliary AUC improves.

Differences explained only by dense clipping, seed sensitivity or Dice-buffer transients limit interpretation to initialization-dependent optimization; they do not establish greater representational capacity.
A single seed, unpaired runtime differences or historical cost comparisons cannot establish repeated support or an efficiency frontier.
alternative_explanations: Shared dense gradient clipping can couple otherwise detached heads to click/buy training
Dice and AdamW dynamics can interact with initial amplitude; one pass cannot distinguish convergence speed from eventual expressivity
Single-seed comparisons, selected prior architecture and noisy wall/inference timing; no independent confirmation
Detached shared embeddings may omit information for cart/fav; the width/depth information bottleneck may dominate regardless of initial scale
Rescaling changes effective AdamW optimization and weight-decay trajectory; Dice approximately normalizes amplitude but is not fully scale invariant
Original and incumbent auxiliary scores are substantially higher; selected low-capacity assignment may have overfit validation choices
